office: the Migration and Citizenship Service of the Ministry of Internal Affairs at home; Armenia's embassies and consulates abroad

routes.label: from the Migration and Citizenship Service

note: Abroad, the consular fees valid from 1 January 2026 under the Law on State Duties: 65,000 drams, and 30,000 drams under 16 (renewal by video identification, 90,000 drams at the posts the Ministry lists, is not modelled). At home the fee is in transition: in August 2026 the acting head of the Migration and Citizenship Service said new biometric passports, issued from autumn 2026, will cost 28,650 drams against 25,000 for the earlier ones, without saying the date or the price for a child, so the home fee is left unpaid until the new one is in force. The passport is issued for ten years; the child's validity is a lead.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Armenia, Consular fees (fees valid from 1 January 2026)
sources.said: 1.1 Issuance (renewal) of biometric passport ֏ 65,000 $168 €149 ₽14000 Pay 1.2 Issuance (renewal of biometric passport of the citizen of the RA under 16 years of age ֏ 30,000 ... The basis of the presented fees is the Law of the Republic of Armenia "On the State Duties"

sources.title: Armenpress, Armenia to begin issuing new biometric identity documents in autumn 2026 (14 August 2026)
sources.said: If our biometric passports issued before the beginning of 2024 cost 25,000 drams, the new biometric document, which is fully competitive globally in terms of its security features and meets the highest standards currently in force in the EU, will cost 28,650 drams, while the ID card will cost 5,950 drams. The passport will be issued for 10 years
